description: The Agorameter is Agora Energiewende's interactive tool showing today's and tomorrow's German electricity mix: current, historical and future electricity consumption and generation from conventional and renewable sources. Its Local Agorameter adds locally resolved electricity prices calculated by a model developed by Fraunhofer IEE with Agora Energiewende, using a dataset of more than 30,000 time series and a simplification of about 450 transmission grid nodes in Germany to 22 hubs, while prices for the single bidding zone equal EPEX spot prices. The Future Agorameter is modelled by Prognos. The page states that model results up to and including 2025 are final-validated and lists limits: very high and very negative prices are not predicted, distribution-grid constraints are not included and the grid model is updated only annually. Version 4.1.4 was published on 7 July 2026, with documentation PDFs for each component. Coverage is Germany. Access: web tool, free; the data download route and licence were not visible in the page text read. Caveats: partly modelled values, not measurements. It suits market and supply-demand analysis, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
